outcome: Presence of microbiota in amniotic fluid
cohort: 24 pregnant women at term undergoing cesarean delivery (10 with intact membranes and 14 with ruptured membranes)
finding: Fetal development in uncomplicated pregnancies occurs in the absence of an amniotic fluid microbiota, with microbial colonization beginning after uterine contractions and rupture of the amniotic membrane.
